chunks: Whatever is in it from Ziyad ibn Suwqah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Ziyad ibn Suwqah.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the author's immediate source in this chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating direct literary transmission.
key_terms.زِيَادِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ: A narrator from whom these reports are transmitted.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: A major transmitter in the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Ziyad ibn Suwqah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Ziyad ibn Suwqah in the book. It serves as a technical statement of transmission, tracing the route through the author's father, Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, Ayyub ibn Nuh, and Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr.
